title: MLB Logo Quiz Part 4: Hard Mode
headline: MLB Logo Quiz Part 4: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard MLB logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of MLB team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current MLB team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

How Every MLB Team Got Its Name

items.piece: The top right corner of the S, brown against white.
items.fact: Since 2020 the Padres have worn their SD in the brown and gold of their 1969 beginnings.

items.piece: The teal and black zigzag along the inside of the A, with red.
items.fact: The Diamondbacks played their first season in 1998 and won the World Series in 2001.

items.piece: The right curve of the S, red against white.
items.fact: In 2019 the Cardinals redrew their interlocking STL into a cleaner, sharper version.

items.piece: Part of the marlin's body: black with a slate-blue outline.
items.fact: The team became the Miami Marlins in 2012, when it moved into its new ballpark.

items.piece: The top of the curly W: red inside a navy outline.
items.fact: The curly W was modeled on the cap of the Washington Senators, the city's last team before the Nationals.

items.piece: The top right serif of the orange S.
items.fact: The interlocking SF debuted at the Giants' first San Francisco home opener in April 1958, and the cap is nearly unchanged since.

items.piece: The end of the T's crossbar, navy with a light blue shadow.
items.fact: The Rays dropped Devil from their name for 2008 and switched to navy and light blue.

items.piece: Navy, blue and white feathers behind the bird's eye.
items.fact: The red maple leaf came back for 2012, when the Blue Jays updated their original mark after dropping the leaf in 2004.
